name: Jerome's U-Pick
tagline: 🍇 Grapes: Pick Your Own at Jerome's
description: Jerome's U-Pick is a family-run pumpkin patch in Naples, NY. It grows Raspberries, Pumpkins, Grapes, and Peas, with picking through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
